answer: Think of Marine surveyor stamp with classification society attestation as a toll booth: each stamp is a surveyed hull certified by a classification society, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real surveyors, so the wander of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The saffron is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The glacier is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
